title: What Did You Do Last Weekend?
fa_title: آخر هفته‌ی گذشته چه کار کردی؟

sents.t: On Monday morning at the bookstore, Emma asks, “Hi, Sam! What did you do last weekend?”
“I had a great weekend,” I say.
“On Saturday morning, I played soccer with Carlos. Then I visited the farmers market with Rosa and bought peaches and corn.”
“I stayed home. I cooked dinner and watched a movie. I was very tired after soccer.”
“I cleaned my apartment and washed my clothes. In the afternoon, I called my family. Then I walked to the lake. The weather was beautiful. And you?”
“I went to my grandparents’ house in Riverside. We had a big family lunch. My grandpa told funny stories, and I helped my grandma in her garden.”
Then Mr. Lee comes in with a big box.
“Good morning! I painted my kitchen this weekend. It was a lot of work!” We all laugh.
There are fifty new books inside.
